criterion_fired: ICP Fit Assessment, Champion Identification, Competition Evidence
suggested_change: ICP Fit: Change 'AND' logic to 'OR' (prospect qualifies if ANY of: 100K+ visitors, modern data stack confirmed, Product-Led motion, or Experimentation Leader role exists). Champion: Define threshold explicitly—e.g., 'Partial (3/10) = expressed interest + stakeholder engagement without internal advocacy; Full (7/10) = active internal selling.' Competition: Clarify whether Firebase status-quo counts as competitive evidence or requires comparison to named competitors; align scoring with available call data.
